note: Le jardin (s02maison repaint 2026-10-22, session 3): the back/side garden west of the laundry and the garage (plan), camera at the west end looking east. LEFT: back wall of the house (white render, half-timbering, green shutters, blue wavy slate roof with the teapot chimney, as in the S02 sector view) with the laundry's open back door (-> R_laundry_01) and a glass veranda. RIGHT: the single-storey garage wing (whitewashed brick, blue slate roof) with its side door open on the workshop (-> R_garage), then the garden wall and gate with the village street seen through the gateway (-> S02_sector; under PR 19 the sector is a crumb, so this way is hover-preview only). LANDMARK: the glass veranda + teapot chimney; the tall hedge with the leaping horse. Feminine left of x=700: grandma in the veranda (véranda), cow munching grass and herbs (herbe), horse leaping the hedge toward a haystack (haie), giant pea on the striped lawn (pelouse). Masculine right: man mowing with a red jerry can of gas (gazon), fox on the gravel path (sentier), glass jar of bees on the gatepost (jardin), fountain in a little box-hedge square (square), big teddy bear in a wooden playpen with toy blocks (parc; b15: the toddler was replaced, no child in the garden), terrier running across the ground (terrain). Zoom: the vegetable patch with the white picket fence (R_garden_z1, Le potager).
